lineage.core_design: silt-filter operating rules and sealed vessel state changes

chapters.title: Red-purge applicability
chapters.body: At the red pressure mark, the purge instruction opens any filter fitted with a copper relief ring for one cycle.

chapters.title: Amber-ring inventory
chapters.body: The basin inventory records that every amber filter is fitted with a copper relief ring.

chapters.title: Cobalt seal definition
chapters.body: For the Cobalt Vessel, the black resin band is the seal: if the band is removed from the vessel, the vessel is unsealed.

chapters.title: Rinse band inventory
chapters.body: After the rinse, the custody sheet places the Cobalt Vessel's black resin band in an inventory sleeve rather than on the vessel.

chapters.title: Kiln pigment
chapters.body: Kesa Thorn mixes the inspection pigment from ochre dust and clear oil.

chapters.title: Gauge tapping
chapters.body: The pressure gauge is tested with four light taps before a shift begins.

chapters.title: Unranked sampler slips
chapters.body: Two sampler slips name different collecting crews, and the register declares no priority between them.

chapters.title: Pending ash assay
chapters.body: The ash assay lists its sample weight but records the composition result as pending.
